 At a glance
 In November, USCIS will accept employment-based adjustment of status applications from foreign nationals with a priority date that is earlier than the applicable Dates for Filing chart date listed in the State Department’s November 2026 Visa Bulletin.
 The employment-based Dates for Filing chart will remain unchanged for all countries and categories, except for modest advancement in the EB-3 Other Worker category for most countries.
 Final Action Dates for countries in most employment-based categories will advance in November, with cut-off date movement ranging from two weeks to several months.
 The EB-1 India, EB-2 India and China, and EB-5 India and China categories will remain at the same Final Action Dates in November.
 A closer look
 According to the State Department’s  November Visa Bulletin , Final Action cutoff dates for issuance of an immigrant visa or approval of an adjustment of status application will be as follows: 
 EB-1 : China will advance by one month to August 1, 2023, and India will remain at February 1, 2023.  All other countries will continue to be current.
 EB-2 : China and India will remain at October 1, 2021, and November 1, 2013, respectively. All other countries will advance by three months to April 1, 2025.
 EB-3 Professionals and Skilled Workers : China will advance two weeks, to January 22, 2022 and India will advance three weeks, to January 22, 2014. The Philippines will remain at August 15, 2023. All other countries will advance by one month, to June 15, 2024.
 EB-5 : For the EB-5 Unreserved categories, China will remain at December 1, 2016, and India will remain at December 1, 2023. All other countries will remain current. The EB-5 set-aside categories (Rural, High Unemployment, and Infrastructure) will also remain current.
 Further, next month, USCIS will accept employment-based adjustment of status applications from foreign nationals with a priority date that  is earlier than the applicable Dates for Filing chart date listed in the State Department’s November 2026 Visa Bulletin . The November employment-based Dates for Filing chart will remain the same for all countries and categories, except for the EB-3 Other Worker category, which will advance by one month to July 1, 2022 for all countries except China, India, and the Philippines.
 To be eligible to file an  employment-based adjustment of status application in November , foreign nationals must have a priority date that is earlier than the Date for Filing listed below for their preference category and country.
 Dates for Filing for November 2026
 EB-1 
China: July 1, 2024
India: July 1, 2024
All other countries: Current
 EB-2   
China: January 1, 2023
India: January 15, 2015
All other countries: March 15, 2026
 EB-3 Professionals and Skilled Workers 
China: April 1, 2024
India: January 15, 2015
Philippines: January 1, 2024
All other countries: August 1, 2024
 EB-3 Other Workers 
China: October 1, 2020
India: January 15, 2015
Philippines: June 1, 2022
All other countries: July 1, 2022
 EB-4  
All countries: January 1, 2025
 EB-5 Unreserved (Regional Center and Non-Regional Center) 
China: March 1, 2021
India: May 1, 2024
All other countries: Current
 EB-5 Set-Asides 
Rural: Current for all countries
High Unemployment: Current for all countries
Infrastructure: Current for all countries
